title: Eventual overlap transition existence
statement: For the directed-colimit core data and supplied φU and φV, there exist k ≥ j, a coherent SchemeTwoOpenComparisonDiagram d, natural isomorphisms κU: derivedPullback(f|U) ⋙ d.HU ≅ derivedPullback(gj|U) ⋙ LU and κV analogously, and site comparisons siteU: PU ⋙ LU ≅ RU and siteV: PV ⋙ LV ≅ RV, where LU and LV are the derived inverse open-site equivalences. There are an overlap isomorphism e and local identifications θU,θV with E satisfying θU=κU.app A ≪≫ LU.mapIso φU ≪≫ siteU.app E and the analogous V equation. Their induced transition is exactly the limit image of e: γU.symm.app A′ ≪≫ SP.mapIso θU ≪≫ τU.app E = HW.mapIso e ≪≫ (γV.symm.app B′ ≪≫ SQ.mapIso θV ≪≫ τV.app E). All functors and comparisons are the exact ones in the core data [def-pc-two-open-comparison-diagram].

proof.text: Restrict the supplied φU and φV to the compact overlap and compose through E, obtaining its prescribed limit transition. Apply perfect morphism descent to the transition and inverse and descend the two inverse equations at a common later stage.

Use composition and open restriction comparisons to form the simultaneous coherent diagram d and functorial transports κU,κV and siteU,siteV. Set θU and θV by transporting the supplied φU and φV. Naturality and coherence retain the prescribed transition as the displayed equality of isomorphisms, rather than dropping it as True.

    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hstage : ∀ (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens),
      ∃ k : I, j ≤ k)
